name: Newsletter Signup Block
description: Provides ready-made blocks for a newsletter signup form (a built-in form and a Webform-backed variant) with configurable heading, description, image, and styling.
project_description:
This module simply creates a newsletter signup block which drives users to a signup page or the full signup process can be completed on the short form. Works best in conjunction with Webform module.

 It is recommended to use Webform module for form setup/display ( https://www.drupal.org/project/webform ).

 Simple form is also included with module, which can be used instead of Webform module.

 Newsletter signup block also provides ability for the following:

 
 General title for block 
 General body for block 
 Background image (can specify image style & responsive image style) 
 Webform to embed
